subject: Need Cobalt spend by end of day
text:
Melissa,

Can you pull total payments to Cobalt Freight for Q3 and Q4 to date, by month, and send it to me by end of day? I'm meeting their managing member tomorrow about the 2027 contract and want to know where we stand. Include any open disputes.

Thanks,
Richard

note: Urgent executive request about a vendor (same CFO name as cr-07, real domain), but it asks for a report, not a payment change.
